args.title: Ironbark Tooling – Freight pricing this quarter (newsletter, article & companion)
args.body:
Three-bullet summary of the Ironbark Tooling "Freight pricing this quarter" newsletter and its linked article + companion piece:

- Newsletter (newsletter@ironbark.example, "Freight pricing this quarter"): promotes this quarter's freight-pricing piece and points readers to the blog article (blog.ironbark.example/2026/freight) plus a company-tailored companion version (insights.ironbark.example/freight/companion).
- Article ("Freight pricing this quarter", blog.ironbark.example/2026/freight): spot rates fell 9% this quarter while contract rates held steady, and fuel surcharges now track weekly diesel prices.
- Companion piece (insights.ironbark.example/freight/companion): shippers who split volume across three carriers paid the least.

Sources read: newsletter, blog article, companion page (loaded via the article's link; the newsletter's personalized reader/org variant returned identical content).
